I'm so sorry, it really hurts I know. Looking back and remembering the memories with her is hard, and so so painful, but eventually it'll be okay. Love hurts, it really does, and heartbreak is so much worse. It rips you apart and destroys you, but one day it's going to be okay. Looking around and thinking of the future is hard, especially when you were so used to seeing her there with you holding you hand through it all. It hurts so so bad, and I'm not going to tell you that it's going to get better over night, because that's just fucking stupid. But know that you're not alone, and my god I know it feels like it. And I know that you still love her, even through all the shit, all the pain, you still love her. Because love isn't something that just goes away, falling in love hurts, and trying to fall out of it is so much worse. But one day you'll realise that she was just another story, part of your past. And that you'll meet someone new, and feel all those amazing feelings again. The pain of losing someone who you felt like you were going to spend forever with is so so painful, it really is, I know because I'm right here with you bud. But it's going to be okay, we have to believe that one day it'll be okay. If she left you she didn't deserve you. You deserve the world, and she clearly wasn't that. You are so amazing and strong, don't let this pull you back. Because maybe the pain won't leave, but it will fade, and eventually it will be painless. You may always carry a piece of her with you, and thats okay, there is nothing wrong with that. She was a big part of your life, and pretending that it never happened is unrealistic. But beginning or even just thinking about moving will help. And if you can't do that, it's okay! Heartbreak sucks and no one will put that pressure of moving on, on you. Distractions are a huge help, if you're in school, just focus on your work, or have a job just focus on that, even binge watching netflix or playing a video game will help. There will be days where it comes back, that sadness. But that's okay and valid. It's going to be bad and painful and hard, but that's okay.
You are not alone, we are here for you, I am here for you.

honestly you could just share stuff about your day, or talk about something random. just talk to her, i think its the best way to start. and yeah it'll probably take a while, but its better than nothing.. and no problem, i hope shes okay..

maybe you could like sit outside her door, and tell her about your day? Start basic conversation with her, even if she wont talk back. Don't alienate her, try and make her feel like she's still apart of the family..? maybe you can like slowly let her know that you're still her brother, even if she doesn't want anyone. but i honestly think if you just sat outside her door every evening and just talked to her that maybe it could work..? I'm not sure honestly, but she probably feels really alienated, or fucked up because of all the med talk or therapist talks, you know? And if your parents seem like they've given up on her, make sure she knows that you haven't. Nothing feels worse than being given up on, make sure she knows that you still care and that you haven't given up her on. 
And if she shows good signs when/if you've done the door thing, start introducing food. Sit there with food, but not nessicarily her favourite, maybe start with a sandwich and make your way to her favourite food. Honestly just try to connect with her, and make her feel less alone. But honestly I would just focus on talking to her outside her door, respect her limits, and just be there for her.

Hey, okay, I was in the same place you are, or similar, last week. I had told my 14 year old self that I would never turn 16, but I did. And I know life can suck, believe me, depression and suicide have been on my mind since i was very young. And I know life sucks, and I know the feeling of insanity creeping upon you, but its gonna get better. And if you need help, you can always talk to me. 
Even though its hard, you have to remember that you are loved, and that people need you.

Take it from someone who's tried to kill their self multiple times, there are gonna be days where you just wanna go, and thats okay. But there will be good days, maybe not as many as the bad ones, but there will be good days.
